shared_context.content: The root theorem is the classical Wilf conjecture: for a numerical semigroup S with embedding dimension e, conductor c, and L = S ∩ [0,c-1], one has e * |L| >= c. This statement is open in full generality as of the present date, although many special cases are known.
shared_context.label: open_problem_notice

strategy_summary: No valid decomposition into independently provable true lemmas is available because the requested root statement is the general Wilf conjecture for numerical semigroups, which is not known to be true in full generality. The only mathematically honest strategy is to isolate standard true facts about numerical semigroups and explicitly record that they do not assemble to the claimed universal inequality without an additional unproved ingredient.
